text: Basaltic lava flows travel further than andesitic ones because their lower silica content reduces viscosity.
Tephra layers deposited by a single eruption can serve as regional time markers in sediment cores.
Harmonic tremor often precedes an eruption as magma forces its way through fractured country rock.
A caldera forms when the roof of an emptied magma chamber collapses under its own weight.
Pyroclastic density currents can exceed two hundred kilometres per hour and hug the ground surface.
Sulphur dioxide flux measured at the summit is a routine proxy for shallow magma degassing.
Phreatomagmatic eruptions occur where rising magma meets groundwater and flashes it to steam.
Lava domes grow by endogenous inflation as well as by extrusion of stiff spines at the surface.
A queen excluder keeps the laying queen out of the honey supers while allowing workers to pass.
Colonies raise emergency queen cells when they lose their queen without warning.
Varroa mites weaken colonies by feeding on the fat body of developing and adult bees.
Bearding on the hive front in hot weather is usually temperature regulation rather than swarming.
Nectar must be reduced below about eighteen percent moisture before bees cap the cell.
A nucleus colony lets a beekeeper build up stock without splitting a productive hive outright.
Propolis collected from tree resin seals small gaps and has antimicrobial properties.
Winter clusters generate heat by shivering flight muscles without moving the wings.
Absolute block working permits only one train in a section between two signal boxes at a time.
Track circuits detect a train by the axles short-circuiting a current fed along the rails.
An interlocking prevents a signaller from setting conflicting routes across the same junction.
Automatic warning systems give an audible indication in the cab when a distant signal is at caution.
Axle counters replace track circuits where poor ballast conditions make shunting unreliable.
Overlap distance beyond a stop signal accounts for a driver overrunning at low speed.
Moving block signalling spaces trains by braking distance rather than by fixed sections.
Facing point locks must be proved before a route through the points can be signalled clear.
Bebop tempos and altered harmony moved the music away from danceable big band arrangements.
Modal playing reduced the rate of chord change and gave soloists longer harmonic fields.
The rhythm section's shift to walking bass freed the drummer from strict timekeeping on the bass drum.
Recording length limits of early discs shaped solo structure for a generation of players.
Territory bands circulating through the midwest spread arranging conventions between regional scenes.
Free improvisation abandoned fixed chorus lengths and predetermined harmonic sequences entirely.
Cool styles favoured lighter articulation and lower dynamic range than the preceding idiom.
Small group formats became economically necessary as large touring ensembles grew unaffordable.
Ring spinning imparts twist and winds yarn onto a bobbin in a single continuous operation.
Mercerising cotton under tension increases lustre and improves dye uptake.
Warp threads run the length of woven cloth and take most of the loom tension.
Carding aligns fibres and removes short lengths before drawing reduces the sliver to roving.
Shuttleless looms insert weft with air or water jets at far higher rates than a flying shuttle.
Fabric weight per square metre remains the primary specification in most supply contracts.
Sizing the warp with starch reduces abrasion damage during weaving and is washed out afterwards.
Staple length governs how smooth and strong the resulting spun yarn can be.
General average apportions loss among all parties when cargo is sacrificed to save the voyage.
A vessel's flag state holds primary regulatory jurisdiction over conditions aboard.
Salvage awards depend on the danger faced and the value of the property preserved.
Bills of lading function simultaneously as receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
Innocent passage through territorial waters may not prejudice the peace or security of the coastal state.
Charterparty disputes commonly turn on laytime and the calculation of demurrage.
Limitation of liability funds cap an owner's exposure by reference to vessel tonnage.
Port state control inspections may detain a ship that fails to meet convention standards.
Moult sequence in the primaries provides a reliable indication of age in many passerines.
Nocturnal migrants orient using a combination of stellar cues and the geomagnetic field.
Brood parasites lay in host nests and shift rearing costs onto another species entirely.
Bill morphology tracks diet closely enough to predict foraging strategy in unfamiliar taxa.
Song learning in some families requires exposure to a tutor within a limited early window.
Ringing recoveries remain the primary evidence for individual movement over long distances.
Countershading reduces visual detection by flattening the apparent form of the body.
Clutch size often varies with latitude even within a single widespread species.
Gathering molten glass on the pipe requires steady rotation to keep the mass concentric.
Annealing relieves internal stress by cooling the finished piece slowly through the strain point.
Marvering shapes and cools the gather against a flat plate before further inflation.
Colour is commonly introduced as crushed frit picked up onto the hot surface.
The punty transfers the work so the original opening can be finished.
Soda lime glass has a longer working range than borosilicate at the same temperature.
Optic moulds impart a ribbed pattern that survives subsequent expansion of the bubble.
Devitrification appears as surface crystallisation when glass is held too long at working heat.
Open market operations adjust reserve quantities and steer the overnight rate toward its target.
Forward guidance attempts to shape expectations about the future path of short rates.
Reserve requirements have declined in importance relative to interest paid on reserves.
An inverted yield curve reflects market expectations of falling rates further out.
Sterilised intervention changes currency composition without altering the domestic monetary base.
Transmission lags mean policy changes affect output well after they are announced.
Inflation targeting frameworks generally publish a numerical objective and a tolerance band.
The effective lower bound constrains conventional easing once nominal rates approach zero.
Optical sizes adjust stroke contrast and spacing so a face reads well at its intended size.
Kerning corrects spacing between specific glyph pairs rather than across the whole run.
Hinting instructs the rasteriser how to snap outlines to a coarse pixel grid.
Measure that runs much beyond seventy characters makes the return sweep harder for the eye.
Old style figures share the lowercase x-height and sit more evenly within running text.
Ligatures resolve collisions between adjacent letterforms such as the f and the following i.
Leading set too tight makes ascenders and descenders of adjacent lines interfere.
A superfamily pairs serif and sans designs on shared proportions and vertical metrics.
Continuous cover approaches maintain canopy while removing individual stems selectively.
Thinning concentrates increment on retained stems and improves final crop quality.
Coppice rotations exploit the ability of certain broadleaves to regrow from cut stools.
Site index expresses productive capacity as height attained at a reference age.
Deadwood retention supports saproxylic species that depend on decaying timber.
Windthrow risk rises sharply once a stand exceeds a critical height to spacing ratio.
Natural regeneration reduces establishment cost but gives less control over species mix.
Increment borers sample radial growth without felling the tree being measured.
The basic reproduction number describes expected secondary cases in a fully susceptible population.
Case control designs sample on outcome and look backwards at exposure history.
Confounding arises when a third factor is associated with both exposure and outcome.
Serial interval measures the time between symptom onset in successive cases in a chain.
Screening programmes must weigh detection benefit against harms from false positives.
Attack rates are computed over the population at risk rather than the whole population.
Ecological studies compare aggregates and cannot support inference about individuals.
Vaccine efficacy from trials often exceeds effectiveness observed in routine use.
Doubled pawns lose flexibility but can open a file for the rooks behind them.
An outpost is a square that cannot be challenged by an enemy pawn.
Zugzwang describes a position where any legal move worsens the mover's standing.
Opposite coloured bishops increase drawing chances in simplified endings.
Development advantage is transient and must be converted before the opponent catches up.
The minority attack aims to create a weakness on the side where one has fewer pawns.
Rook endings are drawn more often than material counts alone would suggest.
Prophylactic moves address the opponent's intention rather than advancing one's own plan.
Every projection distorts some combination of area, shape, distance, and direction.
Generalisation removes detail so that features remain legible at reduced scale.
Contour interval must suit both terrain relief and the intended reading distance.
Datum differences can displace coordinates by hundreds of metres if ignored.
Choropleth shading invites misreading when the underlying units differ greatly in size.
Label placement is constrained by feature geometry and by collision with other labels.
Rhumb lines cross every meridian at a constant angle and appear straight on a Mercator sheet.
Hypsometric tinting conveys elevation bands through a graduated colour sequence.
Bisque firing drives off chemically bound water and makes the ware safe to glaze.
Glaze fit depends on matching thermal expansion between body and coating.
Reduction atmospheres starve the kiln of oxygen and alter metallic oxide colours.
Wedging removes air pockets and aligns platelets before throwing begins.
Grog added to a clay body reduces shrinkage and improves resistance to thermal shock.
Crazing appears when the glaze contracts more than the body beneath it.
Slip casting reproduces complex forms that would be impractical to throw.
Vitrification closes porosity as the body approaches its maturing temperature.
Prestressing introduces compression that offsets tensile stresses under service loading.
Settlement of foundations matters less in absolute terms than differentially across a structure.
Expansion joints accommodate thermal movement that would otherwise induce restraint forces.
Scour around bridge piers remains a leading cause of failure in river crossings.
Compaction increases density and reduces the void ratio of placed fill.
Redundant structural systems retain capacity after the loss of a single member.
Cover to reinforcement protects steel from carbonation and chloride ingress.
Serviceability limits on deflection often govern design before ultimate strength does.
Clonal selection expands lymphocytes whose receptors bind the encountered antigen.
Antigen presentation on class one molecules signals the state of the cell interior.
Affinity maturation improves antibody binding through iterative mutation and selection.
Complement activation proceeds through cascades converging on a shared membrane attack complex.
Regulatory populations suppress responses that would otherwise damage host tissue.
Innate receptors recognise conserved molecular patterns rather than specific epitopes.
Memory populations persist long after the initiating exposure has been cleared.
Thymic selection removes developing cells that react too strongly against self.
Parallax gives direct distances to nearby stars without assuming intrinsic brightness.
Metallicity in stellar spectra traces enrichment by earlier generations of stars.
Transit depth scales with the square of the planet to star radius ratio.
Adaptive optics corrects wavefront distortion introduced by atmospheric turbulence.
Globular clusters contain old populations with little ongoing star formation.
Redshift of distant galaxies increases with distance across the observable volume.
Spectroscopic binaries are identified by periodic Doppler shifts in their absorption lines.
Interstellar extinction reddens starlight by scattering shorter wavelengths preferentially.
Resting roasted meat lets juices redistribute before the fibres are cut across.
Emulsions hold together when an agent keeps dispersed droplets from coalescing.
Browning develops flavour compounds that simple boiling cannot produce.
Salting early draws moisture out and then reabsorbs it as seasoned brine.
Gluten development gives dough the elasticity needed to trap fermentation gases.
Acid added late preserves brightness that prolonged heating would dull.
Low temperature cooking narrows the gradient between surface and centre doneness.
Starch gelatinisation thickens sauces only once a sufficient temperature is reached.
Trace fossils record behaviour rather than the anatomy of the organism that made them.
Lagerstätten preserve soft tissue that ordinary depositional settings destroy.
Biostratigraphy correlates strata using the ranges of short-lived index taxa.
Taphonomic bias favours hard parts and shallow marine settings in the record.
Phylogenetic bracketing infers soft tissue traits from living relatives on either side.
Growth series show that many named forms were juveniles of known species.
Permineralisation replaces void space with mineral while retaining cellular detail.
Mass extinction boundaries are defined by turnover rather than by absolute diversity.
